tagline: Serving customers across the UK with a range of retail and commercial banking products and services.
hero_kpi_rationale: Remarkable improvement in the cost-to-income ratio from 53.6% to 48.4%, reflecting increased operational efficiency despite investments in technology transformation and compensation.

kpis.name: Total Income
kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated from banking activities including interest margins and hedging income.
kpis.description: Total income increased by £1.779 billion (13%) to £15.312 billion, driven by improved deposit margins linked to higher customer balances.
kpis.signal: Double-digit growth driven by expanding deposit margins and strong hedging revenues.

kpis.name: Operating Expenses
kpis.explanation: Operating costs including compensation, transformation, and process simplification expenses.
kpis.description: Operating expenses increased by £154 million (2%) to £7.405 billion, primarily due to transformation and compensation costs related to process simplification.
kpis.signal: Strict cost control maintained despite investments in technology transformation and compensation.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Cost-to-income ratio measuring operational efficiency and profitability after operating expenses.
kpis.description: The cost-to-income ratio improved from 53.6% to 48.4%, demonstrating enhanced operational efficiency despite moderate expense growth related to transformation.
kpis.signal: Significant improvement in operational efficiency with an optimal cost-to-income ratio.

kpis.name: Net Impairment Losses
kpis.explanation: Provisions for doubtful loans and asset impairment losses, including the impact of acquisitions.
kpis.description: Net impairment losses increased from £373 million (2024) to £676 million (2025), reflecting reduced positive releases and a charge related to the acquisition of Sainsbury's Bank's loan portfolio.
kpis.signal: Increase in impairment losses due to lower accounting releases and integration of...

kpis.name: Net Loans to Customers
kpis.explanation: Total outstanding loans to customers after impairment provisions, the primary earning asset.
kpis.description: Net loans to customers increased by £12.7 billion (3.5%) to £379.6 billion, driven by growth in mortgage, personal, and commercial lending.
kpis.signal: Sustained credit portfolio growth across all customer segments.

kpis.name: Customer Deposits
kpis.explanation: Total deposits collected from customers, a stable and growing funding source.
kpis.description: Customer deposits increased by £7.1 billion (1.8%) to £403.5 billion, driven by growth in retail savings and current account balances.
kpis.signal: Stable and growing deposit base supporting credit expansion.

kpis.name: CET1 Ratio
kpis.explanation: Financial strength ratio measuring high-quality capital against risk-weighted assets.
kpis.description: The CET1 ratio decreased by 20 basis points from 12.6% to 12.4%, due to an £8.7 billion increase in risk-weighted assets, partially offset by a £0.8 billion increase in CET1 capital.
kpis.signal: Solid capital level compliant with regulatory requirements despite limited decline.

kpis.name: DPS
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last seven fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of 23.0 GBp in the latest year.

kpis.name: Cap Return
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last four fiscal years reported.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of £2.376 billion in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout Ratio = Dividends Paid / Net Income, calculated over the last four fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Proportion of net income distributed as dividends: 40.7% in the latest year.

kpis.name: Loan to Deposit Ratio
kpis.explanation: Ratio of loans granted to deposits collected, an indicator of funding balance and sustainability.
kpis.description: The loan-to-deposit ratio remained stable at 94.1% (£379.6 billion / £403.5 billion), reflecting a sustainable balance between credit growth and deposit expansion.
kpis.signal: Stable ratio demonstrating balanced and sustainable funding management despite credit growth.

kpis.name: Dividend Payments
kpis.explanation: Total amount of interim dividends paid to the sole shareholder NatWest Group plc.
kpis.description: Two interim dividends of £1.938 billion (February 2025) and £1.821 billion (July 2025) were approved by the Board, totaling £3.759 billion and reflecting a distribution policy of approximately 50% of profits.
kpis.signal: Significant surplus capital returned to the parent group in line with distribution strategy.

risks.title: Credit and Counterparty Default Risk
risks.score_rationale: Risk identified at the beginning of dedicated section (strong position), direct language « fail to meet a contractual obligation », stable trend but fundamental to banking activity, credit category = high weight in prudential regulation.

risks.title: Liquidity and Funding Risk
risks.score_rationale: Major risk addressed in dedicated section with comprehensive framework (central position), language of importance « maintain sufficient capital », stable trend but reinforced by regular stress testing, capital category = high regulatory weight.

risks.title: Economic and Macroeconomic Stress Risk
risks.score_rationale: Central risk identified with extensive stress testing, language of impact « adverse economic and market conditions », stable trend but heightened by geopolitical context, macro category = high weight for systemic bank.

risks.title: Climate and Energy Transition Risk
risks.score_rationale: Emerging risk addressed in dedicated section (mid-to-late position), language of limitation « immaturity of modelling techniques and limitations surrounding data », new/increasing trend with internal exercises in 2025, environmental category = growing regulatory weight.

risks.title: Resolution and Business Model Viability Risk
risks.score_rationale: Existential risk addressed in dedicated section (central position), critical language « business model to become unviable », stable trend but reinforced by mandatory reverse stress testing, regulatory category = existential weight.

risks.title: Market and Asset Volatility Risk
risks.score_rationale: Risk identified in dedicated section (central position), technical language « gap risk, basis risk, credit spread risk », stable trend with robust ICAAP methodology, technology/models category = medium weight.

risks.title: Climate Communication and Misinformation Risk
risks.score_rationale: Risk identified in internal exercise 2025 (late position), moderate language « omit or contain incorrect information », new trend with external focus on communications, reputation category = medium weight.
